title: 2nd box I've received worst box
text:
[[VIDEOID:f2700644a138dd0965eeb55476e95c7e]] So lack luster. The whole reason I like beauty boxes is because i get things new, something I've never seen. Or something unique. Or something a little bit more expensive. And always some type of pallete.
This month, March 2023, was a disappointment. The Tarte Maneater Mascara is good. The Cotz Flawless Complection Tinted is great but it's TINY. Its a one use suze. The Mielle strengthening oil is Awesome and I'm happy about that product because I can use it. I just would like a bigger bottle. My hair is to my butt! The Mudmask Eye Serum is fine and in a decent size. I also like eye care products. Next is a Belif, tiny, lip mask. And I won't use it. Followed by Dionis Hand And Body Goat Cream. I won't use that. And finally a MINI Cetaphil Deep Hydration. It's about a one time use.
I thought I would be getting full size products and palletes from the Allure Box Co. But I guess I was wrong. I should have stayed with BoxyCharm. BoxyCharm is the same price and with BoxyCharm I'd get full size products. This box was a complete rip off and a joke.
My f I estimate box was great, A+. This one sucked, D.
label: negative
